verdict.rationale: The docs show that after installing the CLI and logging in (`npm i -g vercel`, `vercel login`), running the bare `vercel` command deploys a project. The getting-started page frames this as install, optionally add agent support, then deploy. However, no evidence shows a CLI command that scaffolds a new project from a template; the GitHub README lists choosing a template and using the CLI as separate onboarding paths. Missing for 10: a documented CLI scaffolding command (e.g. creating a new project from a template), a single combined scaffold-and-deploy command, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the CLI deploy flow.
